CustomField.description: Which Experience Cloud customer user this contact can get (Enable/Disable Customer User actions, Inv_CustomerUser). Blank = none. Dealer Portal: B2B account with relation type Dealer or Distributor.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "B2B", OR( ISPICKVAL(Account.Relation_type__c, "Dealer"), ISPICKVAL(Account.Relation_type__c, "Distributor") ) ), "Dealer Portal", null )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which customer portal user this contact can get. Blank = none.
CustomField.label: Customer User Type
